subject.title: [Bug] WebSocket payload truncation causes silent parser drop in gateway-client protocol

question: Should this report be retained for a gateway investigation after the reporter provides a current-main reproduction showing an application payload is truncated rather than normally reassembled by the WebSocket transport?
rationale: The available report proposes a protocol redesign but does not demonstrate the claimed current behavior or identify the exact wire-level boundary; maintainer direction is needed before expanding a compatibility-sensitive protocol.

options.title: Request focused evidence
options.body: Ask for a current-version reproduction with payload size, gateway/client logs, and a redacted protocol trace that proves application-level truncation.

options.title: Investigate internally
options.body: Have a gateway-area owner reproduce with a controlled oversized tool result before deciding whether protocol changes are warranted.

recommendation.title: Request focused evidence
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-version reproduction with payload size, gateway/client logs, and a redacted protocol trace that proves application-level truncation.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for a gateway/protocol ownership decision; source-history attribution could not be established from the supplied review evidence.
